basic_info.description: Unbeatable Value. Welcome to 901 Bayshore Blvd, a beautifully updated third-floor condo featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Nestled at the rear of the building, this home offers a peaceful setting away from the hustle and bustle of city life, with plenty of natural light streaming through its windows.  The unit boasts serene views of Silver Terrace Athletic Fields, providing a calming backdrop and fresh, open-air vibes. Ideal for unwinding or enjoying intimate gatherings. Residents also have access to a third-floor common area, perfect for socializing and taking in impressive views.  Designed for those aged 55 and older, this community cultivates a warm and inviting atmosphere  Ideally located, this property combines tranquility with proximity to urban conveniences. Seize the chance to make this exceptional condo your new home. Schedule a private showing today and experience the charm and serenity of Silver Park Condominiums!
